title: A Conversation with One of my Heroes

body:
For years, I’ve been a fan of the work of Sr. Ilia Delio and the Omega Center. I’m honored to be in a 90 minute Zoom conversation with Sr. Delio (and hopefully you too) on Thursday, Jan 21. We’ll talk about “Faith and Doubt: A Love Story,” relating to my new book, Father After Doubt (available here starting today: https://read.macmillan.com/lp/faith-after-doubt/ )

 You can register to be part of this conversation here:

 https://christogenesis.org/faith-and-doubt-a-love-story…/
